english.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for being in or going to various places.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for covering a broad physical area or many places.
Use this for moving, travelling, or spreading around a large area, rather than for abstract scope.
Use this for going or spreading all over a place, as in travelling 周圍.
This is the all-purpose choice for moving from place to place or doing something in various places or with various people.

examples.english: Walk around and you'll see convenience stores everywhere.
examples.traditional: 周圍行吓都見到便利店。
